displayIdentity.body: Meekness and spiritual weapons answer judgments of weakness. Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you. and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.
